CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_routing (order_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, mode VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'split', created_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_line_jobs (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, order_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, line_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, supplier_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'assigned', revision INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, previous_status VARCHAR(30) NULL, hold_note VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', carrier VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', tracking VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', assigned_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, accepted_at VARCHAR(40) NULL, printed_at VARCHAR(40) NULL, dispatched_at VARCHAR(40) NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, UNIQUE KEY uq_order_line (order_id,line_id), INDEX idx_supplier_status (supplier_id,status,updated_at), INDEX idx_order_status (order_id,status))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_line_preflights (line_job_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, snapshot_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL, report_json LONGTEXT NOT NULL, approved_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, approved_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_line_evidence (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, line_job_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, upload_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, kind VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', submitted_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, reviewed_by VARCHAR(64) NULL, review_note VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, reviewed_at VARCHAR(40) NULL, INDEX idx_line_evidence (line_job_id,kind,status))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_line_issues (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, line_job_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, note VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, severity VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', created_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, resolved_by VARCHAR(64) NULL, resolution VARCHAR(1000) NULL, resolved_at VARCHAR(40) NULL, INDEX idx_line_issue (line_job_id,status))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_line_packaging (line_job_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, snapshot_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL, checks_json TEXT NOT NULL, checked_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, checked_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_line_messages (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, line_job_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, author_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, body VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL, created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, INDEX idx_line_messages (line_job_id,created_at))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_line_deadlines (line_job_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, accept_by VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, production_by VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, dispatch_by VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_manufacturing_invoices (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, supplier_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, invoice_number VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft', note VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, reviewed_by VARCHAR(64) NULL, reviewed_at VARCHAR(40) NULL, payment_reference VARCHAR(160) NULL, UNIQUE KEY uq_supplier_invoice (supplier_id,invoice_number), INDEX idx_supplier_invoices (supplier_id,status,created_at))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_manufacturing_invoice_lines (invoice_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, line_job_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, quantity INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, unit_cost_minor INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, tax_minor INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (invoice_id,line_job_id), UNIQUE KEY uq_manufacturing_job (line_job_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_api_credentials (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, supplier_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, label VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, token_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE, scope VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, created_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, revoked_at VARCHAR(40) NULL, expires_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, last_used_at VARCHAR(40) NULL, INDEX idx_supplier_credential (supplier_id,revoked_at))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_sla_events (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, line_job_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, milestone VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, UNIQUE KEY uq_line_sla_event (line_job_id,milestone,kind))
